faq_heading: Homes near Hyland Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Hyland Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Hyland Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Hyland Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Hyland Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 103 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,163,750, townhomes $752,000, condos $490,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Hyland Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Hyland Elementary the median was 27 days on the market, closing at 97.2% of the list price, with 11% of sales above the list price for the 103 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Hyland Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are McLeod Road Traditional (0.8 km south-east), Georges Vanier Elementary (0.8 km north-east) and iLearn Secondary School Society (1.2 km south-west).

Hyland Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 6677 140 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Hyland Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Hyland Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Hyland Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Hyland Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 103 homes sold within 1 km of Hyland Elementary: 26 houses, 66 townhomes and 9 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $752,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Hyland Elementary

27 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Hyland Elementary in a straight line (18 elementary, 6 secondary, 3 other; 5 independent). The closest is McLeod Road Traditional, 0.8 km away, and the farthest on this list is Tamanawis Secondary, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is iLearn Secondary School Society (1.2 km); the nearest independent school is iLearn Secondary School Society (1.2 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (1.6 km). Other elementary schools close by: McLeod Road Traditional (0.8 km south-east), Georges Vanier Elementary (0.8 km north-east), Henry Bose Elementary (1.2 km west), Woodward Hill Elementary (1.2 km south), North Ridge Elementary (1.4 km south-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is McLeod Road Traditional, 0.8 km south-east of Hyland Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Hyland Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Hyland Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past Hyland Elementary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median townhome within 1 km of Hyland Elementary was $752,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at McLeod Road Traditional, the nearest other elementary school, 0.8 km south-east of Hyland Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
